name: discovery-loop
_comment: loop until done + adversarial verification. For work of unknown size, where finding one issue reveals three more. Finders run in parallel on different search modalities (each is blind to what the others surface); every round dedupes against EVERYTHING ever seen, and the run stops after two consecutive rounds turn up nothing new.

for_each: by container: walk each module/package boundary
by data flow: follow untrusted input to where it is used
by error path: read what happens when each call fails
